summary: ansible-core 2.22 adds a secret masking API that lets modules and plugins register sensitive values, which are replaced with $REDACTED$ in all output without changing the value.
questions: What is the secret masking API in ansible-core 2.22?
What placeholder replaces registered secrets in output?

answer_card.title: Secret masking API overview
answer_card.answer_md: Since **ansible-core 2.22**, modules and plugins can register sensitive values. Registered values are replaced with `$REDACTED$` wherever Ansible writes output, but the value itself is unchanged.
